Offered beside the drones it reads as the shield you wanted, and taking it spends points on a rule the model does not have. Reported by the app's user, who fields the army. BSData does not list it either way, so this is still ours to state (§3.10).
It does take a Gun Drone, which BSData does not list: the reference export — a validated 2,000 point list that prices to its printed total — has "1x Gun drone with twin pulse carbine" on every Commander in it.

BSData offers one in the datasheet's wargear budget but not among its abilities, and the importer resolves a drone by its ability — so "Gun Drone With Twin Pulse Carbine and Shield Drone" landed on the shield drone alone and the carbines went missing. The export lists one on every Crisis suit in the list.

BSData has no Gun Drone on this datasheet, and the reference export — a validated 2,000 point list that prices to its printed total — has "1x Gun drone with twin pulse carbine" on every Commander in it.
Gun Drone, as for the Fireknife and on the same evidence.

The MV15 Gun Drone's gun, carried by The Twin Lance. Upstream names it only as free text — "twin pulse blaster" — with no record to resolve. Written out rather than derived: the profile confirmed against the datasheet is 12" with TWIN LINKED, where upstream's `pulse-blaster` is 10" without it, so this is not simply its namesake at BS5+.

expert-fieldcraft.name: Expert Fieldcraft
expert-fieldcraft.description: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly **PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS** unit is **selected to shoot**, those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being **hidden**.

negation-emitters.description: **STEALTH BATTLESUITS** unit only. This unit has -3" **detection range**.

**BATTLESUIT** model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model’s Airbursting Fragmentation Projector weapons. That weapon’s attacks have:

- +1 **AP** and **D**.

thermoneutronic-projector.name: Thermoneutronic Projector

**BATTLESUIT** model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model’s T’au Flamer weapons. That weapon’s attacks have:
- +2 **S**
- +1 **AP** and **D**.

plasma-accelerator-rifle.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
plasma-accelerator-rifle.description:
**BATTLESUIT** model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model’s Plasma Rifle weapons. That weapon’s attacks have:
- +2 **S**
- +1 **A**, **AP** and **D**.

enforcer-commander.name: Enforcer Commander
enforcer-commander.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **CRISIS BATTLESUITS**
- **CRISIS FIREKNIFE BATTLESUITS**
- **CRISIS STARSCYTHE BATTLESUITS**
- **CRISIS SUNFORGE BATTLESUITS**

deep-strike.name: Deep Strike
deep-strike.description: Each time this unit makes an **ingress move** (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

for-the-greater-good.name: For The Greater Good
for-the-greater-good.community_notes: Assumes targets are SPOTTED (observer unit sacrifices shooting). +1 BS is the primary offensive benefit; Ignores Cover is kept for completeness but has no effect in the current damage engine (cover not simulated).
for-the-greater-good.description:
If your Army Faction is **T’AU EMPIRE**, at the start of your Shooting phase you can select units from your army with this ability to become Observer units.

During your Shooting phase, for each Observer unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is eligible to shoot (excluding **FORTIFICATION** and Battle-shocked units) select one enemy unit that is visible to be marked as their Spotted unit until the end of the phase. Each enemy unit can only be marked as a Spotted unit once per phase.

Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability (excluding Observer units) are Guided units while targeting one or more Spotted units.

Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your army in a Guided unit makes an attack that targets a Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if the Spotted unit was marked by an Observer unit that has the Markerlight keyword, that attack has the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

corrected.reason: A Gun Drone brings a twin pulse carbine. Upstream records only `{grant_type: ranged-weapon}` with no weapon named, so the app could say "grants a ranged weapon" and nothing more — no profile, no attacks, and nothing in the shooting table. The Recon Drone in the same file shows the intended shape, with an explicit weapon_id.

weapon-support-system.name: Weapon Support System
weapon-support-system.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

battlesuit-support-system.name: Battlesuit Support System
battlesuit-support-system.description: The bearer is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back but it loses the **Smoke** keyword.

marker-drone.name: Marker Drone
marker-drone.description: The bearer’s unit has the **Markerlight** keyword and can act as an Observer unit for another unit even if it Advanced this turn.

shield-drone.name: Shield Drone
shield-drone.description: Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

guardian-drone.name: Guardian Drone
guardian-drone.description: Each time a model makes a ranged attack that targets the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

fireknife.name: Fireknife
fireknife.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that attack targets a unit that is at its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

coldstar-commander.name: Coldstar Commander
coldstar-commander.description: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 12" and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

corrected.reason: While the Commander leads a unit, the whole squad's ranged weapons gain ASSAULT as well as moving 12". Upstream carries only the Move part, so the app showed a mobility buff and said nothing about being able to shoot after Advancing — which is the reason to take the detachment.

shield-generator.name: Shield Generator
shield-generator.description: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

starscythe.name: Starscythe
starscythe.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack (excluding attacks that target MONSTERS and VEHICLES), improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

corrected.reason: The AP improvement does not apply against VEHICLE or MONSTER targets. Upstream has no restriction, so the app promised -1 AP against exactly the targets where it does not help.

neocapacitor-shields.name: Neocapacitor Shields
neocapacitor-shields.description: At the start of your opponent’s Charge phase, you can select one visible enemy unit (excluding **MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units) within 12" of this unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the turn, subtract 1 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

exemplars-of-montka.name: Exemplars of Mont’ka
exemplars-of-montka.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** and **[IGNORES COVER]** abilities.

retro-thrusters.name: Retro-thrusters
retro-thrusters.description: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, this unit can either make a Normal move of up to 6" or a Fall Back move.

scouts-8.name: Scouts 8"
scouts-8.description:
This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
- If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a **scout move**.
- If that unit is embarked within a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** has the Scouts ability, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** can make a **scout move**.

mv15-gun-drone.name: MV15 Gun Drone
mv15-gun-drone.description: The bearer is equipped with 1 twin pulse blaster.

corrected.reason: Names the weapon by id rather than as free text, so the grant resolves to a profile the shooting table can show.

advanced-armour.name: Advanced Armour
advanced-armour.description: Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

corrected.reason: Advanced Armour is Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds only. The upstream effect has no qualifier, so the app rendered an unrestricted Feel No Pain 4+ — a much stronger ability than the Broadside has, and exactly the kind of confidently wrong number that loses games.

feel-no-pain.name: Feel No Pain
feel-no-pain.description: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

corrected.reason: Names the weapon the drone brings, as the Recon Drone already does. Without a weapon_id the grant is unresolvable and the drone's shots never reach the table.

stealth-drones.name: Stealth Drones
stealth-drones.description:
Twice per battle, after an attack has been allocated to this model, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

Designer’s Note: Place two Stealth Drone tokens next to the unit, removing one each time this ability has been used.

deadly-demise-d3.name: Deadly Demise D3
deadly-demise-d3.description:
This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
**Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Then the Intercessors make an **emergency disembark move**. Then the roll is made for the **Deadly Demise** ability, and on a 6, that ability is resolved. Finally, the Impulsor is removed from the battlefield.*

infiltrators.name: Infiltrators
infiltrators.description: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

lone-operative.name: Lone Operative
lone-operative.description:
Unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit.
If this ability takes the form **Lone Operative X"**, unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within **X"** of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within **X"** of this unit.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08).

corrected.reason: In 11th edition Stealth gives the unit the Benefit of Cover. Upstream still carries the 10th edition rule, -1 to the attacker's Hit roll, in all three faction files. Reported by the app's user against the current rulebook. The two are not interchangeable: cover changes the save, a hit penalty changes the roll, and they stack differently with everything else on the table.

nova-charge.name: Nova Charge
nova-charge.description: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot in your Shooting phase, select one ranged weapon equipped by this model. Until the end of the phase, that weapon has the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

deadly-demise-d6.name: Deadly Demise D6
deadly-demise-d6.description:

Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. **Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. forward-observers.name: Forward Observers
forward-observers.description: Each time this unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is made by a model in a Guided unit that targets their Spotted unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

homing-beacon.name: Homing Beacon
homing-beacon.description:
Once per battle, you can use the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP. The target must be set up within 3" of the bearer’s unit and more than 8" away from all enemy units.
**Designer’s Note:** *Place a Homing Beacon token next to this unit, removing it once this ability is used.*

command-re-roll.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
command-re-roll.text:
**WHEN:** Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model:

• **Advance roll**
• **Charge roll**
• **Damage roll**
• **Hazard roll**
• **Hit roll**
• **Save roll**
• **Wound roll**
• A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.

**TARGET:** That unit or model.

**EFFECT:** You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding **charge rolls**, which you must re-roll in full).

counter-offensive.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
counter-offensive.text:
**WHEN:** Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.

**TARGET:** One friendly unit that is **eligible to fight**.

**EFFECT:** Until the end of the phase, your unit has the **Fights First** ability and it must be the next unit you **select to fight** (12.04).

epic-challenge.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
epic-challenge.text:
**WHEN:** Fight phase, just after a friendly **CHARACTER** unit is **selected to fight**.

**TARGET:** That **CHARACTER** unit.

**EFFECT:** Select one **CHARACTER** model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

insane-bravery.name: INSANE BRAVERY
insane-bravery.text:
**WHEN:** Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a **battle-shock roll** for a friendly unit.

**TARGET:** That unit.

**EFFECT:** That **battle-shock roll** is automatically successful.

**RESTRICTIONS:** You cannot use this **stratagem** more than once per battle.

explosives.name: EXPLOSIVES
explosives.text:
**WHEN:** Your Shooting phase.

**TARGET:** One friendly **unengaged** **EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES** unit that is **eligible to shoot** and did not make an **advance move** this turn.

**EFFECT:** Resolve the following sequence:
1. Select one **EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES** model in your unit.
2. Select one **unengaged** enemy unit within 8" of and **visible** to that model.
3. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **mortal wound** (06.02).

crushing-impact.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
crushing-impact.text:
**WHEN:** Your Charge phase, just after a friendly **MONSTER/VEHICLE** unit ends a **charge move**.

**TARGET:** That **MONSTER/VEHICLE** unit.

**EFFECT:** Resolve the following sequence:
1. Select one enemy unit **engaged** with your unit.
2. Select one model in your unit **engaged** with that enemy unit.
3. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 **mortal wound**; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **mortal wound** (to a maximum of 6 **mortal wounds** per unit).

rapid-ingress.name: RAPID INGRESS
rapid-ingress.text:
**WHEN:** End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

**TARGET:** One friendly unit that is in **strategic reserves** (excluding AIRCRAFT).

**EFFECT:** Your unit makes an **ingress move** (20.04).

**RESTRICTIONS:** You cannot use this **stratagem** during the first battle round.

fire-overwatch.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
fire-overwatch.text:
**WHEN:** End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

**TARGET:** One friendly **unengaged** unit (excluding **TITANIC** units).

**EFFECT:** Your unit shoots using **snap shooting** (see below).

smokescreen.name: SMOKESCREEN
smokescreen.text:
**WHEN:** Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

**TARGET:** One friendly **SMOKE** unit.

**EFFECT:** Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your **SMOKE** unit, or a unit that is not **fully visible** to the attacking model because of one or more models in your **SMOKE** unit, the target has the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08).

heroic-intervention.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
heroic-intervention.text:
**WHEN:** End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

**TARGET:** One friendly **unengaged** unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.

**EFFECT:** **Resolve a charge** with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the **charge roll**, you must select one of the following modes:

• Leap to Defend: When selecting **charge targets**, you can only select enemy units that made a **charge move** this phase and are within the **maximum distance**.
+1CP
• Into the Fray:

• When making the **charge roll**, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
• When selecting **charge targets**, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the **maximum distance**.

autoreactive-camouflage-advanced-acquisi.name: Autoreactive Camouflage
autoreactive-camouflage-advanced-acquisi.text:
**WHEN:** Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/ STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit, if that friendly unit is hidden.

**TARGET:** That PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.

**EFFECT:** Your unit has +1 **Sv**.

experimental-ammunition-experimental-pro.name: EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION
experimental-ammunition-experimental-pro.text:
**WHEN:** Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit is selected to shoot.

**TARGET:** That BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit.

**EFFECT:** Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

• +1 **S**.
• **OR:** +1 **S**, **AP** and [HAZARDOUS].

marker-beacon-advanced-acquisition-cadre.name: Marker Beacon
marker-beacon-advanced-acquisition-cadre.text:
**WHEN:** End of your Movement phase.

**TARGET:** One friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.

**EFFECT:** Select one objective your unit is controlling. That **objective** is secured.

microdrone-support-advanced-acquisition-.name: Microdrone Support
microdrone-support-advanced-acquisition-.text:
**WHEN:** Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/ STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit starts an action.

**TARGET:** That PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.

**EFFECT:** That **action** does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
